concept.title: Support for a person with a learning disability or autism
concept.shortdesc: As an adult with a learning disability or autism, or their family, I need activities and support designed for us, so that I can take part and get help with daily life.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-034). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Who: people with a learning disability, autistic people, their families.
Situation: Audience and access matter as much as the activity.
A good result: Groups and services that say they are for the person, with what support is provided and how to get a place.
How much it matters: Important: a miss leaves someone without help they need.
